crew.overview: King Charles VI declares that Knight Jean de Carrouges settle his dispute with his squire, Jacques Le Gris, by challenging him to a duel.

crew.overview: Jep Gambardella has seduced his way through the lavish nightlife of Rome for decades, but after his 65th birthday and a shock from the past, Jep looks past the nightclubs and parties to find a timeless landscape of absurd, exquisite beauty.

crew.overview: Set in the Mayan civilization, when a man's idyllic presence is brutally disrupted by a violent invading force, he is taken on a perilous journey to a world ruled by fear and oppression where a harrowing end awaits him. Through a twist of fate and spurred by the power of his love for his woman and his family he will make a desperate break to return home and to ultimately save his way of life.
crew.title: Apocalypto

crew.overview: A hardened gun-for-hire's latest mission becomes a soul-searching race to survive when he's sent into Bangladesh to rescue a drug lord's kidnapped son.
crew.title: Extraction

crew.overview: Virgil Oldman is a world renowned antiques expert and auctioneer. An eccentric genius, he leads a solitary life, going to extreme lengths to keep his distance from the messiness of human relationships. When appointed by the beautiful but emotionally damaged Claire to oversee the valuation and sale of her family’s priceless art collection, Virgil allows himself to form an attachment to her – and soon he is engulfed by a passion which will rock his bland existence to the core.
crew.title: The Best Offer

crew.overview: As the Avengers and their allies have continued to protect the world from threats too large for any one hero to handle, a new danger has emerged from the cosmic shadows: Thanos. A despot of intergalactic infamy, his goal is to collect all six Infinity Stones, artifacts of unimaginable power, and use them to inflict his twisted will on all of reality. Everything the Avengers have fought for has led up to this moment - the fate of Earth and existence itself has never been more uncertain.
crew.title: Avengers: Infinity War

details.biography:
Matteo Silvi is an Italian makeup artist. He comes from a family deeply rooted in cinema, with four generations dedicated to the craft of makeup for film. His great-grandfather began as an actor before moving into makeup, and his father, Maurizio Silvi, became one of Italy’s most celebrated makeup artists, earning international recognition with BAFTA wins and Oscar nominations. Growing up in this environment, Matteo was exposed to film sets from an early age. At just 17, he accompanied his father to Australia for work on Moulin Rouge! (2001), an experience that ignited his determination to follow in the family tradition, despite his father’s initial hesitation about his pursuing the same career path.

Over the years, Matteo Silvi has established himself as a leading figure in makeup design and execution across major international productions. His career includes contributions to The Avengers (2012), Everest (2015), Spectre (2015), Men in Black: International (2019), and Hercules (2014). He has become exceptionally well known for his work with Marvel Studios, where he served as Italy Crowd Makeup Supervisor on Avengers: Age of Ultron (2015), personal makeup artist to Chris Hemsworth in Avengers: Infinity War (2018) and Avengers: Endgame (2019), and head of the makeup department for Thor: Love and Thunder (2022).

Beyond Marvel, he worked as a makeup designer for Ridley Scott’s The Last Duel (2021), served as department head on Sam Hargrave’s Extraction (2020), where he created intricate prosthetics, wounds, and scars, and returned for Extraction 2 (2023). He was also the makeup designer for Stillwater (2021). He collaborated again with Chris Hemsworth as personal makeup designer for Furiosa: A Mad Max Saga (2024).

Prestigious institutions have recognised Matteo Silvi’s work. He was nominated for the David di Donatello Award for Best Makeup in 2011 for Angel of Evil (2010), alongside Francesco Nardi. In 2016, he received a nomination at the Hollywood Makeup Artist and Hair Stylist Guild Awards for Best Contemporary Makeup for Youth (2015), shared with his father, Maurizio Silvi.

In addition to his film work, Silvi is committed to education, teaching as an Associate Professor at the Accademia Nazionale del Cinema in Bologna. He is also represented by The Milton Agency, working globally across major productions. He is fluent in Italian, English, and Spanish.
details.name: Matteo Silvi
